source: Neely & Kim 1986 Table I as ORIGINALLY printed gives m2=0.5e-3*exp(x) (exponentially growing with x); Elliott, Ku & Lineton (2007) JASA 122:2759-2771, Table I, publish this as a corrected typographical error -- constant, not exponential. Verified against cochleasim.analysis.response.gain_active_vs_passive: with kind=exp the model gave 33.8 dB gain at 6.4 kHz vs. the paper's 63 dB; fixing to kind=const (this row) reproduces 63.0 dB

Neely & Kim 1986 Table I as printed; Elliott-Ku-Lineton (2007) mistakenly 'corrected' this to 10.0*exp(-0.8x), then their own 2011 erratum (JASA 130:3158) corrected it back to 2.0*exp(-0.8x) -- confirms the original 1986 value was right all along

Neely & Kim 1986 Table I as printed; Elliott-Ku-Lineton (2007) mistakenly 'corrected' this to 10.0*exp(-0.8x) (identical to their also-wrong c3), then their own 2011 erratum (JASA 130:3158) corrected it back to 1040*exp(-2x) -- confirms the original 1986 value was right all along

Neely & Kim 1986 Table I as printed gives H=0.1cm; Elliott, Ku & Lineton's 2011 erratum (JASA 130:3158) to their 2007 paper, 'Mistake 1', explicitly corrects H to 0.002m=0.2cm. This row now uses the corrected value
Neely & Kim 1986 Table I (not given; Pd(L)=0 used)

Neely & Kim 1986 Table I gives N=251 (their original grid size); informational only, solve_pressure's own N argument governs the actual solve. Raised to 1000 here since N=1000 is required at 25.6 kHz to avoid mesh-resolution artifacts (see cochlear_model.py docstring)
